g.text: The E1 lift exists for every v. A uniform projection removes all available E2 corrections.

g.text: Even projection uses the reflection w ↦ −w, with w = 2Z + Q. The surviving equations are quadratic in v.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17323b

g.text: Actual coefficient map: five selected physical monomials × six nonzero quadratic columns

text.style: font-size: 11.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: Nine other quadratic columns are zero in these five rows and are omitted. Entries are exact rational coefficients, not numerical scores.

g.text: Zero even projections checked: 5 direction coefficients × 25 complete Koszul corrections = 125 images, plus all 15 quotient images.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #53666d

g.text: The denominator coefficient map is injective, so a nonzero direction really gives a nonzero class modulo G.

text.style: font-size: 11.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17323b

g.text: This is an exact obstruction with complete numerator freedom for this family; it does not exclude other degree-five denominators or solve the target.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #166a70
